checked.claim: The Despair bar's overflow caption takes no pointer on a desk layout, so its title (the GM's real count and why a full counter has not fired) never shows and a click on it falls through.
checked.why: The caption is appended straight to the #drpg-despair wrapper (despair.mjs:1047-1048), not inside a .drpg-despair-row, so it does not inherit the row's opt-in. #drpg-despair sets pointer-events none on itself and opts back in only the row, pip, button, name and count. A scan of every rule in styles/*.css with pointer-events whose selector names despair, overflow, #ui-top, #drpg-column or a universal selector found only those two rules for the panel; stained-glass.css's caption rules set no pointer-events. On the narrow stack #drpg-column > * gives the panel pointer-events auto, and the caption inherits it there, as the reader says. Foundry's core stylesheet was not readable here, but the panel's own declaration on the element would still beat any inherited value; only an explicit descendant rule could undo it, and the module's own opt-in list exists because none does (its note). One narrowing: the real count is not in the tooltip only - the Despair explainer, opened by a click on a row, prints the GM's count through DRPG.Overflow.gmHint (explain.mjs:311), but not the queued / darkened-full reasons, which only the tooltip carries. Minor still fits.
